lessons.rule: Product at true size: the 50 ml roll-on sits in a palm. Prompt with a hand holding it and use the Products tab photos; check every product shot against them (#300 #355 #357 #395)
Must pass as real phone footage: natural light, real skin texture, no studio look; cover long AI talking heads with b-roll under the voice (#227 #291 #357 #370)
Duplicates: copy the reference's structure, scenes, timing, captions and music; never add the product where the reference has none (#302 #366 #227)
Voice matches the reference (gender, age, accent); listen to the whole VO for pronunciation: numbers, years, HAY-vin & SPOOL, riss-in-oh-LAY-ik (#386 #297 #422)
Watch every export frame by frame before upload: no blips, tweaks or stray bars (#309 #266)
Apply a strategist's copy change to every hook version, not only the one the note is on (#307 #332)
Say the angle keyword in the hook itself (e.g. 'Skin tags freezing kits vs...') (#423)
Castor seeds whole only; never chewing, crushing or rubbing a raw seed on skin (#457)
